unlockLines: Tech support unlocked. Turn the bullshit off and back on again. If that fails, tell them the vibes have a virus.
Become a certified computer doctor. Your qualification is owning a mouse. Please stop checking the laptop's pulse with a fucking thermometer.
The computer has a virus! Conveniently, your boss has a gold-chain deficiency. Two emergencies. One highly questionable business opportunity.
Say firewall like you know what it means. Last week you called the toaster a server. Confidence, beta. Confidence.
Sell protection with your serious nerd voice. If they ask for your credentials, remember: you once successfully opened a PDF.
